notes: «قال هذا ما حدثنا أبو هريرة» is Hammam's own statement that this is Abu Hurayra's material; Abu Hurayra is the last link
The second saying («وقال رسول الله ... والذي نفس محمد») has no isnad of its own; it rides on the same chain, so no saying labels
«فذكر أحاديث منها» introduces several sayings under one chain
